page.overview:
Who is Bianca?

Bianca was a fictional intelligence operative employed by the British Secret Service. A minor character and Bond girl, she appeared in EON Productions' 1983 James Bond film Octopussy and was portrayed by Tina Hudson.

Bianca aided James Bond when he arrived in Latin America to destroy an enemy spy plane. Meeting him at a horse-training event, Bianca provided Bond with a disguise, complete with the fake moustache, in order to make him look like Colonel Luis Toro. However, Bond's cover was blown whilst infiltrating the aircraft's hanger, and attempting to place the Attaché Briefcase Bomb by the spy plane. Minutes later, Bianca had then spotted Toro's paratrooper guards driving away with a captured Bond. She sped up to the vehicle in her Land Rover Range Rover Convertible and flashed her bare thighs to distract the guards. Seizing the opportunity, Bond had pulled the rip cords on the guards' parachute harnesses. Before Bond escaped in an Bede BD-5J, hidden in the back of the Jeep's horse trailer, he then kissed Bianca goodbye and said that he would meet her in Miami.
